worker:  array, and one that an unknown format's message contains the requested name and every registered name.
- **Defaults assertion:** the `['csv', 'json']` check runs at the top of the test file, before any test registers an exporter, so test order doesn't affect it. Each test registers its own uniquely named exporter.
- **ADR (extra):** I added `docs/adr/0001-exporter-registry.md` with Context, Decision and Consequences sections, because the mission criteria require it.

No interfaces other tasks depend on changed, apart from the `exportData` unknown-format error message, which is now longer.

On commit, git warned that LF will be converted to CRLF in the three changed files; I left that alone.

worker:  format throws `Unknown format "<format>". Known formats: <names>`.
  - `listFormats()` returns the names sorted.
  - A new format goes in its own file that calls `registerExporter`.
- **Consequences:** adding a format edits no existing file. The registry is process-global, so a format exists only once its module is imported. Name collisions fail at registration, there is no unregister or override, the built-ins stay in `index.js` to avoid an import cycle, and json and csv output is unchanged.

I checked the ADR against `src/export/index.js` as it stands; I did not open `src/export/index.test.js`. Git warned that line endings will be converted from LF to CRLF on this file; I left that alone.
